Admission Requirement
For Applicants with Local Degree
REQUIREMENTS
Grades from Local Universities
(Based on First Degree and
Waiver of GRE and TOEFL/IELTS)
Relevant Bachelor Degree with at least 2nd Upper Honours/Honours (Distinction) # or better
# Please refer here for the new Classification of Degree for undergraduate programmes.
For Applicants with Overseas Degree
REQUIREMENTS
Grades from Overseas Universities
(Based on First Degree)
Relevant Bachelor Degree with 1st Class Honours or equivalent
Grades from China Universities
(Based on First Degree)
Relevant Bachelor Degree with average grade of 85% or better
Grades from India Universities
(Based on First Degree)
Relevant Bachelor Degree with 1st Class Honours (with Distinction)
AND
Provide one of the following
TOEFL
(With validity of 2 years from date of application)
Internet Based Test ≥ 105
IELTS
(With validity of 2 years from date of application)
Minimum Score ≥ 7.0
TOEFL/IELTS Requirement may be waived if medium of instruction for applicant’s tertiary studies (minimum 3 years) was conducted in English
Certification letter for medium of instruction from applicant’s tertiary institution must be provided during application
GRE
(With validity of 5 years from date of application)
Minimum Verbal Reasoning Measure (V) ≥ 153
Minimum Quantitative Reasoning Measure (Q) ≥ 149
Minimum Analytical Writing (AW) ≥ 3.5
Total V+Q ≥ 319
India - Can replace with GATE score
(With validity of 3 years)
≥ 97%
